arguments:
set -Eeuo pipefail
export GIT_PAGER=cat PAGER=cat GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
tmp="$(mktemp -d /tmp/vps-legacy-route-remove.XXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
git clone --quiet --depth 2 --branch hygiene/vps-passive-supervisor-only-20261031 https://github.com/martaxi-boss/VPS.git "$tmp/repo"
cd "$tmp/repo"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = 3567f4a6fc86c7139287fdcbd1bf0c81335150a5
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import ast
workflow=Path(".github/workflows/agent-switch.yml")
assert workflow.is_file()
workflow.unlink()
obsolete=Path("ops/tests/test_codex_resume_stage_routing.py")
assert obsolete.is_file()
obsolete.unlink()
changed=[]
for file in sorted(Path("ops/tests").glob("test_*.py")):
 tree=ast.parse(file.read_text())
 lines=file.read_text().splitlines(keepends=True)
 removed=[]
 for item in tree.body:
  if isinstance(item,ast.ClassDef):
   for method in item.body:
    if isinstance(method,(ast.FunctionDef,ast.AsyncFunctionDef)) and method.name.startswith("test_"):
     source="".join(lines[method.lineno-1:method.end_lineno])
     if "agent-switch.yml" in source:
      from_line=min([method.lineno]+[d.lineno for d in method.decorator_list])
      removed.append((from_line,method.end_lineno,method.name))
 if removed:
  for start,end,name in sorted(removed,reverse=True):
   del lines[start-1:end]
  file.write_text("".join(lines))
  changed.append((str(file),[m[2] for m in removed]))
file=Path("ops/tests/test_portable_coordinator_retirement.py")
s=file.read_text()
old='''    "codex-autonomous-validation.yml",
)
INERT_WORKERS = (
    "agent-switch.yml", "codex-autonomous.yml",
'''
new='''    "codex-autonomous-validation.yml", "agent-switch.yml",
)
INERT_WORKERS = (
    "codex-autonomous.yml",
'''
assert s.count(old)==1
file.write_text(s.replace(old,new,1))
print("ROUTER_WORKFLOW_REMOVED",flush=True)
print("RETIRED_OBSOLETE_TEST_FILE",str(obsolete),flush=True)
for path,names in changed:print("RETIRED_ROUTER_TESTS",path,",".join(names),flush=True)
PY
git diff --check
python3 -m unittest -q ops.tests.test_portable_coordinator_retirement ops.tests.test_telegram_gateway ops.tests.test_supervisor_live ops.tests.test_supervisor_cloud_source ops.tests.test_supervisor_audit > "$tmp/focused.log" 2>&1
set +e
python3 -m unittest discover -s ops/tests -p 'test_*.py' -q > "$tmp/full.log" 2>&1
code=$?
set -e
python3 - "$tmp/focused.log" "$tmp/full.log" "$code" <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import sys
for path in sys.argv[1:3]:
 data=Path(path).read_text(errors='replace')
 for line in data.splitlines():
  if line.startswith(('Ran ','OK','FAIL: ','ERROR: ','FAILED (')):
   print('SUITE',Path(path).name,line[:210],flush=True)
print('FULL_TEST_EXIT',sys.argv[3],flush=True)
PY
test "$code" -eq 0
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,hashlib
paths=subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--name-status'],text=True).splitlines()
for line in paths: print('PATCH',line,flush=True)
for line in paths:
 if line.startswith('M\t'):
  name=line.split('\t')[1]
  print('SHA256',name,hashlib.sha256(Path(name).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),flush=True)
